text:
- Locate roller; if first locate returns a small/wrong object, re-locate with the instruction description. Grasp left/right ends/tips of major axis; avoid body-centre grasps.
- If a grasp is loose (finger_opening >0.5), off-end, or one arm unreachable, home/release, carry roller to xy [0,-6], height 3-6, re-grasp ends; do not nudge with move.
- Lift both to 12 cm; after lift OK for both arms, require both gripper_z within 0.2 cm and roller level. If lift PLAN_FAIL or slipping, reset and re-grasp.
- All practice failures passed verify, so verify is necessary but not sufficient: before done, verify holding left/right and lifted 9, then inspect images; if roller is not clearly visible/held at ends, re-grasp.
- Stop after passing; leave other objects undisturbed.
goal: Roller held by both arms at its ends, level, bottom lifted about 10 cm (verify lifted 9), other objects undisturbed.
